message: No detected input validation: There are no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards applied to the data loaded via TS_dataset or open_data; data is consumed directly without validation.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local filesystem paths only (no remote URLs, S3, or Hub calls), and no checksum or integrity verification is performed on those local files.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: Although `detectOutliers` flag exists, it is set to False and applies only post-training via a separate detect module; no statistical anomaly checks or outlier filtering are applied to training samples during data preparation.

No detected model integrity verification: Model weights are loaded via `vrae.load('vrae/models/model_gaus.pth')` or `vrae.load('vrae/models/model_vamp.pth')` with no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision before loading.

No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks class balance, verifies expected label sets, or detects anomalous training samples before training begins; the only label-related filtering is selecting label==1 in SplitDataSet.py without any distribution checks.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No backdoor or trigger detection mechanisms (e.g., neural cleanse, activation analysis, gradient anomaly detection) are present anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or DP mechanisms are imported or used in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) or robustness stress tests are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although train/val/test splits exist, there is no evidence of hashing/signing evaluation data, strict isolation enforcement, or use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: The code loads datasets directly via TS_dataset and passes them to the model without any shape, range, or schema validation checks.
No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs (reconstructions, latent vectors) are used directly without any NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or threshold validation.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a time-series VAE model, not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
